en.name: Blacksmith
en.ability: The 1st time the Demon kills you, you live & gain a not-in-play Townsfolk ability.

revisions.v1: The 1st time the Demon kills you, you live & gain a not-in-play Townsfolk ability.

en.flavor: "Every new beginning comes from some other beginning’s end." - Lucius Annaeus Seneca 4 B.C. - 65 A.D.
en.otherNightReminder: If the Blacksmith was killed by a Demon. Show the Blacksmith a not-in-play Townsfolk character token. Swap the not-in-play character token with the Blacksmith token. Place the IS THE BLACKSMITH token next to the not-in-play character token. Wake the Blacksmith and show 'You are', then their new character ability.

zh.name: 铁匠
zh.ability: 当你首次将要被恶魔杀死时，你不会死亡并获得一个不在场镇民的能力。

revisions.v1: 当你首次将要被恶魔杀死时，你不会死亡并获得一个不在场镇民的能力。

zh.flavor: ‘每个新的开端都来自于一些其他开端的结束。’-吕齐乌斯·安涅·塞涅卡 前4-65
zh.otherNightReminder: 如果铁匠首次将要被恶魔杀死，唤醒铁匠并向他展示“你是”信息标记和他的新角色标记。
